0290e9b5a8bb.en: The [#HusbandOutWorld repo](https://github.com/Deovandski/HusbandOutWorld/tree/main/Legacy/Behind%20The%20Scenes/Illustrations/World%20Map) has the full-resolution world map (with and without names), the metadata map (populations, altitudes, villages), a Sanbi city map, embassy art, and the global map of the western continent. The metadata map's kilometer labels are canon, but you don't need them at the table.
0290e9b5a8bb.t: [#HusbandOutWorld仓库](https://github.com/Deovandski/HusbandOutWorld/tree/main/Legacy/Behind%20The%20Scenes/Illustrations/World%20Map)里有全分辨率的世界地图（带名字和不带名字的）、元数据地图（人口、海拔、村庄）、桑比城市地图、大使馆插画，以及西部大陆的全图。元数据地图上的公里标注是官方设定，但跑团时用不着。

14d1d26ca726.en: green, grey, white, then grey up the east coast
14d1d26ca726.t: 绿色、灰色、白色，然后沿东海岸北上的灰色

2acc73d59453.en: The table map for the West March: the world map with **circles drawn along the roads and sea lanes connecting places**. Each road has its own colour so you can follow it across the map.
2acc73d59453.t: 西境的桌面地图：一张**沿着连接各地的道路和航线画着圈**的世界地图。每条路都有自己的颜色，方便你在地图上一路追踪。

2b51b722702b.t: [![弗拉基西境旅行地图：沿着各地之间的道路和航线画着彩色圆圈的世界地图](web/west-march-map-2400.jpg)](Vraki%20World%20Map%20-%20West%20March.png)

65d4ab386238.t: 还有一条白色航线从桑比–恩德莱斯福格航线（与特赖安格尔航线交会处）向南分出，经过11个圈后在开阔的海面上结束。

75b7861847ca.en: **For screens:** [2400 px](web/west-march-map-2400.jpg) and [5000 px](web/west-march-map-5000.jpg) copies. The website has the map with zoom and pan.
75b7861847ca.t: **用于屏幕：** [2400 px](web/west-march-map-2400.jpg)和[5000 px](web/west-march-map-5000.jpg)的版本。网站上的地图可以缩放和拖动。

9d508eab4816.en: light blue, to the north edge

9e261a7d148e.en: How many circles each road or sea lane on the map takes. For a trip through several places, add up the legs (Forway → Sanbi → Cruro is 6 + 10 = 16 circles). The encounter table is a suggestion for which [Events & Encounters](../D&D%20Campaign/07%20-%20Events%20&%20Encounters.md) table to roll on; switch it when a trip crosses into other country.
9e261a7d148e.t: 地图上每条道路或航线占多少个圈。要经过几个地方的旅程，就把各段加起来（福威 → 桑比 → 克鲁罗是6 + 10 = 16个圈）。遭遇表一栏是建议你掷[事件与遭遇](../D&D%20Campaign/07%20-%20Events%20&%20Encounters.md)里的哪张表；旅程进入别的地区时就换表。

a0e98cadf6bf.en: **Count the circles** between where the party is and where it's going. Count every circle on the way. A circle next to a town counts for every road that leaves from it, and where two roads share circles (like the two green circles just north of Sanbi), count them on both.
a0e98cadf6bf.t: **数一数**队伍所在地和目的地之间的圈。路上的每个圈都要数。城镇旁边的圈对从那里出发的每条路都算数；两条路共用圈的地方（比如桑比正北的那两个绿圈），两条路都要算上。

a35ba9a0312e.en: **Keep a shared copy** and mark the circles your parties have traveled or explored. DMs can draw new circles as parties push into unknown land.
a35ba9a0312e.t: **保留一份共享的副本**，在上面标出你们的队伍走过或探索过的圈。当队伍深入未知之地时，DM可以画上新的圈。

bbeeed41a1f0.en: **Each circle is 1, 2 or 3 days of travel. The DM chooses**, trip by trip, to make the journey shorter or longer. Forway to Sanbi is 6 circles: 6 days at Fast, 12 at Standard, 18 at Slow.
bbeeed41a1f0.t: **每个圈代表1、2或3天的旅程。由DM每次旅行选择**，让路途变短或变长。福威到桑比是6个圈：快速6天，标准12天，慢速18天。

c70adeb9a7f1.en: These lanes run off the map. The count is to the edge; the DM decides how far the rest is.
c70adeb9a7f1.t: 这些航线一直延伸到地图外。圈数只算到地图边缘；剩下还有多远由DM决定。
